purpose: Proposed next research gates; does not replace or loosen the existing frozen numerical/eligibility plan

currentScope.threeDimensional: Continuous polyhedral layers, ordered oblique fault slip and prescribed erosion, derived nodal velocities and full3D acoustic shots

milestones.name: Spatial material memory and supported 3D stratigraphy
work: Represent burial/loading history within supports when the value varies spatially; a single fragment-wide scalar cannot generally capture later nonuniform burial
Define free surfaces, exposed boundaries and incoming material explicitly
Extend validated prescribed erosion toward supported deposition and complete histories, without filling unsupported voids or repairing grain mass
gates: Exact reduction to established 2D cases when crossline uniform
Independent vertical-ray/point membership and surface-support checks
Per-bed constituent budgets and resolution/fragment refinement studies
Preserve irreversible memory through burial, uplift, faulting and reburial

milestones.name: Conservative 3D compaction and pressure evolution
work: Specify a Lagrangian compaction mapping and how it changes non-axis-aligned interfaces
Choose an adaptive geometric/memory approximation with a stated convergence error
Retain separation of authoritative material state from display or acoustic voxels
gates: Independent one-dimensional compaction and loading oracles
Consistent interfaces, no overlaps and physically defined boundary flux
Monotone refinement error on inclined and oblique heterogeneous cases

milestones.name: Scale real 3D workloads
work: Profile fragment growth, ray projection, wave propagation and serialization separately
Evaluate deterministic native parallelism and GPU wave propagation against the validated scalar solver
Keep sparse/shared material regions; request only necessary projections and traces
gates: Frozen workload definitions, accuracy limits and hardware before timing
Compare end-to-end throughput and measured peak memory, including transfer/setup costs
Check physical outputs and convergence before accepting lower precision or approximation
Report browser and native behavior separately

milestones.name: Matched SubsurfaceGen and downstream comparison
work: Agree comparable geological families and physical domain/resolution, acquisition and resource budgets
Freeze training/inversion splits and task metrics before scoring
Compare geological diversity, structural/material validity and downstream seismic generalization
gates: Independent observations or benchmark tasks that were not used for development
Common workloads and hardware for speed/memory claims
Uncertainty and repeated seeds; no superiority claim from a single attractive example
Reserved FORCE holdout remains unread and unscored until its separately authorized frozen evaluation
